name: Dr. Elizabeth Harper
goals: Find balance between work and family

relationships.description: Struggling with communication and trust issues, leading to unresolved conflicts

history_notes: Saved over 200 patients in her career
Married James for 10 years before recent strain
current_state: Reviewing patient records while contemplating a therapy appointment for her marriage.
facts_they_know: Believes that perfection in surgery guarantees patient recovery
Underestimates the impact of emotional labor on her personal life
beliefs: Her surgical perfection directly correlates with patient survival
Personal failures stem from lack of assertiveness in relationships
factual_errors: Assuming that her work stress negatively affects her marriage is a misconception; stress can improve problem-solving skills in relationships
